scope.description: Focused construction of one completion-endpoint identity case: an assigned index that is decided while the entry originally assigned to it was overwritten.
assumptions: 3 nodes, majority quorum; in-process delivery under harness control
node 1's traffic is isolated in both directions while node 2 takes over, so node 1's entry cannot be adopted
node 1 is re-admitted through a Promise + AcceptSync cycle, which is the protocol's normal re-synchronization path
excluded: any claim about how often this interleaving occurs in a deployment

basis.prefix: Three real OmniPaxos instances (pid 1,2,3) over MemoryStorage, each driven by a real omnipaxos_runtime actor from spawn_actor with a harness-local tokio-backed AsyncRuntime impl. The transport is explicit: a pump task per node moves outgoing messages into a shared queue and a delivery task pops them and calls the receiver's handle_incoming, dropping messages whose sender or receiver is currently isolated (`blocked`/`blocked_in`). Node 1 has leader_priority 10 and becomes the leader after the initial heartbeats. Sequence: node 1 is first isolated in both directions; `node1.append_notify(TestEntry(42))` is then accepted locally at index 1 (its own entry, read back as Undecided) and never leaves the node; `node2.try_become_leader()` makes node 2 the leader with node 3's promise (its log is empty, since node 1's entry never left), and `node2.append_notify(TestEntry(99))` is decided at index 1 by node 2 and node 3; node 1 is then un-isolated and asked to reconnect to node 2, which makes it promise node 2, receive an AcceptSync that truncates its log to node 2's and raises its decided index to 1. The case emits CA_EVENT after_b_takeover {b_leader,c_leader,a_leader,b_decided,c_decided} and CA_EVENT overwritten_index_resolution {a_decided_idx,a_entry_at_index_1_is_own,b_decided_idx,b_idx,resolution}, and asserts that the resolved call reports Ok(idx) while the entry at that index on node 1 is not the entry that call submitted (and that node 2's own entry was assigned a different index). RuntimeConfig: tick_period 2000ms (so the resolution tick cannot land between node 1's promise change and the sync), egress_period 1ms, append_notify_timeout 5s.
